items.text: How are preoperative anaemia pathways for elective hip and knee replacement organised, in terms of screening point, referral triggers, clinic leadership, treatments offered and their location, and times from screening to treatment and surgery?
items.population: Adults awaiting elective hip or knee replacement
items.concept: Organisation of preoperative anaemia pathways, including where treatment is given
items.context: Hospitals and health systems offering elective joint replacement

items.text: How do pathways reach patients who live far from the treating centre, and what do patients report about travel, communication and postponement?
items.population: Patients referred to preoperative anaemia pathways, especially those living far from the centre
items.concept: Access to treatment and patient-reported burdens
items.context: Pathways serving rural or dispersed populations

finer: Still feasible within 120 resident hours; the access question uses the same search and charting form.
